GITHUB_CLIENT_ID.description: Client ID of your GitHub OAuth App (not a GitHub App)

GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret of the same GitHub OAuth App

COOKIE_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Random secret for signing cookies. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

ALLOWED_GITHUB_LOGINS.description: Comma-separated GitHub usernames allowed to use this server (yours). Anyone else is rejected.
